title: Mini Body Butter Balm Pistachio Milk - Rich Body Cream with Hyaluronic Acid

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Lotions & Body Oils > Body Moisturizers > Bath & Body
specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Hyaluronic Acid✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Warm & Spicy Scent✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Hydrating✓ Vegan

What it is: A rich body cream that nourishes the skin while treating the senses.


Fragrance Family: Warm & Spicy


Scent Type: Warm & Sweet Gourmands


Key Notes: Pistachio Milk, Creamy Woods, Raspberry Sugar


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-On dry skin, massage all over your body for rich, comforting moisture.
-Wear each scent on its own, or pair the balm and mist together in Vanilla (sold separately), Pink Guava (sold separately) or Pistachio Milk for a layered fragrance.
Ingredients+
Water/Aqua/Eau, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Glycerin, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Oil, Propanediol, Cetearyl Alcohol, Cetyl Ethylhexanoate, Dipentaerythrityl Hexa C5-9 Acid Esters, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Cetearyl Olivate, Polyglyceryl-3 Methylglucose Distearate, Diisostearyl Malate, Astrocaryum Murumuru Seed Butter, Shorea Stenoptera Seed Butter, Ceramide NP, Phytosphingosine, Squalane, Arginine, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Oil, Brassica Campestris (Rapeseed) Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Sorbitan Olivate, Polysorbate 60, Hydroxyacetophenone, Potassium Cetyl Phosphate, Caprylyl Glycol, Tromethamine, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Behenyl Alcohol, Arachidyl Alcohol, Triethylhexanoin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Arachidyl Glucoside, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Glyceryl Stearate, Stearic Acid, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Carbomer, Fragrance (Parfum), Vanillin, Benzaldehyde, Hexyl Cinnamal.
